title: Promptset versioning, rollout & rollback workflow with access-first curation
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Problem: We lack a clear, auditable lifecycle for 'reference prompt corpora' used by evals and regression gates. Changes to promptsets (edits, reweighting, or deletion) can silently affect quality checks tied to config or model rollouts, causing unexpected regressions or false positives/negatives. Teams currently copy prompt lists in ad-hoc locations, making rollbacks and permissioning difficult.

Proposal: Build a first-class Promptset Versioning and Rollback workflow that prioritizes curated access (access-first curation) and ties each immutable promptset version to eval artifacts, preflight checks, and automatic regression alerts triggered on model/config changes. Deliverables include: stable storage of immutable versions, human review + programmatic gating for changes, RBAC-managed edit flows, a Console UI for diff/approve/rollback, API primitives for referencing promptset@version in eval/configs, and infra hooks that surface per-prompt metrics in the Console.

Why this matters: Model or config changes should not be able to degrade a production SLO without an explicit, auditable approval and a tested rollback path. Promptset versioning reduces flakiness in evals, makes blame attribution simpler, and enables safer canary rollouts when paired with automated regression gates.
acceptance_criteria: Immutable promptset versions can be created, listed, and retrieved via API and Console UI
Promptset edits must produce a new version; existing evals reference promptset@version and do not mutate historically
RBAC controls: only users in 'prompt-curators' or with explicit permission can approve new versions; audit logs record user, timestamp, and diff
Preflight: when a model/config change is proposed, the system runs selected eval suites against the target model+promptset@version and fails rollout on regression thresholds
Rollback: Console provides a one-click rollback to a previous promptset version in the route/rollout policy and executes an automated smoke eval
Regression alerts are created automatically when a model/config change increases error rates on golden prompts beyond configured thresholds
Migration: import tool to onboard existing prompt lists into the new registry with provenance metadata

decisions: All promptset edits are append-only: new version created on every change; no in-place mutates
Eval configs reference promptset by immutable tag (promptset_id@vN); runtime ensures historical evals use referenced version
Approval workflow: 'curators' role + optional secondary reviewer for P0 promptsets; enforced in Console and API
Automatic gating: default regression threshold set to 2x baseline false-positive rate or absolute 5% drop on core metrics; configurable per project
